polityNote: Kingdom of Sweden. First level = län. The scope starts 1974-01-01, when the kommun reform was complete and SCB's list of kommun changes begins (the 1971–1973 reform moved parishes between län and is not proven here); it ends the day before the 1998-01-01 Västra Götaland merger, from which data/hist-admin-fill.js draws the present län. Each län is the union of the 2017 kommuner (geoBoundaries SWE ADM2) whose 1995–1996 SCB code carries its län number; the only kommun to change län after 1974 and before 2017 outside the 1997/1998 mergers is Heby (2007), assigned to Västmanland here. Boundary adjustments of single properties between kommuner (fastighetsreglering) are not in SCB's list; none across a län line is known to us, but the list cannot prove their absence.
